title: Checks for IP addresses that could be replaced with predefined constants such as Ipv4Addr::new(127, 0, 0, 1) instead of using the appropriate constants.
summary: Using specific IP addresses like 127.0.0.1 or ::1 is less clear and less maintainable than using the predefined constants Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST or Ipv6Addr::LOCALHOST. These constants improve code readability, make the intent explicit, and are less error-prone. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.
